description: Checks height, separation, floor area, setbacks and lot coverage of a garden suite against Toronto By-law 849-2025. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/garden-suite-zoning-checker?zone=yes&laneway=no&lot_area=400&lot_depth=40&lot_frontage=10&house_gfa=180&house_footprint=90&ancillary_footprint=40&suite_height=4&separation=5&suite_gfa=50&rear_setback=2&side_setback=1.5&one_storey=yes&rear_openings=no&side_openings=yes

ancillary_footprint.description: Footprint of all ancillary buildings together, including the suite (m2)

house_gfa.description: House gross floor area, all floors (m2)

rear_openings.description: Rear lot line abuts a residential-zone lot and the rear wall has openings more than 4.0 m above grade

separation.description: Distance from the main wall of the house (m)

side_openings.description: Side wall facing a side lot line (not a street) has doors or windows

suite_gfa.description: Suite gross floor area, all floors including a basement (m2)

zone.description: Property is in a residential zone (R, RD, RS, RT, RM)

name: garden-suite-zoning-checker
title: Garden suite zoning checker
